Paiṭhīnasi
------------------------------------------
The वेदस् and the उपनिषद्स् give a general outline of philosophy and एथिच्स्. They do not deal with the daily routine or social conduct of persons living in their society.
This, however, has been done by later writers through whose works, evolved a set of literature, now well-known as धर्मशास्त्रस्. (See DHARMAŚĀSTRAS.)
One of the earliest works in the category of धर्मसूत्रस् is that of पैठीनसि. Though his work has not been recovered, fragments of the same have been culled from other works which have quoted him.
He perhaps was a follower of Atharva-veda.
A few of the topics on which he has been quoted are: मर्रिअगे within the गोत्र permitted if it is beyond third degree on मोथेर्’s side and beyond the fifth on ड़थेर्’s side; service to the husband as the greatest austerity for a wife; on the practice of सती (immolation of the wife on the funeral pyre of her husband); regarding the इन्हेरितन्चे of the property of a sonless man after his death; non-observance of अशौच (ceremonial impurity) at certain times like मर्रिअगे or famine or पिल्ग्रिमगे.
His period is not known even approximately.
